description: Words public text here must not use. Third-party products appear as categories with their public documentation pinned as a reference, never by product name, with no endorsement and no integration implied (owner, 2026-10-21). Microsoft's own products are named as the sources name them. The one partner this family names is Liquidware, and only in the notice and the partner rule. tests/check_wording.py scans every tracked text file except this one. Private project names are kept out by the family guardrail, not listed here.

useInstead.SSE or ZTNA client: a secure service edge or zero trust network access client, as a category
useInstead.VPN client: a VPN client, as a category
useInstead.EDR: an endpoint detection and response product, as a category
useInstead.monitoring product: a third-party monitoring or user experience product, as a category
